## 自检 / Self-check

- [ ] `npm test` 全绿（smoke / route / client / render / opensource / release 六个）/ `npm test` is green (all six suites)
- [ ] 没有新增依赖 / no new dependencies
- [ ] 没有改动系统提示词段、没有重写历史前缀（三条硬约束见 README）/ no change to the system-prompt section, no rewritten history prefix (see the three hard constraints in README)
- [ ] 文档（README / 运维手册）已同步 / docs (README / operations manual) updated
- [ ] 新增的对外文案是中英双语、中文优先 / new user-facing text is bilingual, Chinese first

## 关于自动关闭 / About the auto-close

正文少于 20 字符、或没有关联 issue 的第三方 PR 会被机器人自动关闭，这不是针对谁，
只是为了过滤批量脚本提交。有真实改动被误关，直接在 issue 里喊一声。
Third-party PRs whose body is shorter than 20 characters, or that link no issue, are closed
automatically. It is not personal — it filters bulk script submissions. If a real change gets
caught by it, just say so in an issue.
